verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS AI control plane and MCP gateway, so the axis applies. The pack shows only vendor-hosted endpoints, a CLI that manages platform resources, and a GitHub repo describing features; nothing documents deploying or running the Control Plane on your own infrastructure. Proxying third-party or tunneled MCP servers is an adjacent capability, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
